artifacts.summary: Confirms both named gate failures (state-writer boundary, whole-tree orphan) currently pass with 0 findings, documents the state-writer remedy already applied and its reasoning, explains the orphan finding's likely transient/concurrent-batch cause, and flags an unrelated out-of-scope doc-lint line_count drift observed live.

next_steps: Run /plan 151 to formalize the remedy documentation and regression note; a full bash agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/verify-deploy.sh run already confirms gates 12 and 13 pass, so implementation should be limited to recording/confirming rather than further code changes unless the plan phase finds otherwise.

memory_candidates.content: lint-state-writer-boundary.sh's guard is checked against a fixture's OWN copy of state-write.sh, not the real one: test-force-phases.sh's setup block copies state-write.sh plus its full dependency chain (task-lock.sh, generate-todo.sh, deploy-root-guard.sh, lib/*.sh) into $WORKDIR/.claude/scripts/ before running. Since state-write.sh resolves PROJECT_ROOT from its OWN invoked script path (common_repo_root "$SCRIPT_DIR" 2), not from $SKILL_REPO_ROOT/cwd/env, invoking "$WORKDIR/.claude/scripts/state-write.sh" self-targets $WORKDIR/specs/state.json correctly with zero extra plumbing. This means a test fixture writing to a scratch WORKDIR should route through its own copy of the sanctioned writer rather than hand-rolling jq+mv or reaching for an allowlist/lint-narrowing exception -- the sanctioned writer already supports being pointed at an arbitrary root.

verify-deploy.sh's gate 13 (find_orphans) and gate 5 only extract and expose their raw per-finding detail lines into FINDINGS_LIST when run with --findings; a plain default run discards the specific finding text even though the shell variable holding it (e.g. orphan_output) was already captured. This is why a transient gate-13 finding observed during an unrelated multi-task /orchestrate batch could not be re-diagnosed later -- only the summary count survived. Any future occurrence should be captured immediately (re-run with --findings, or log $orphan_output to a file) rather than relying on the summary alone.
